$comment: Versioned snapshot of actionlint's YAML representation of ShellCheck directives. Normal generation does not overwrite this file; see scripts/generate-config-schema/README.md.
title: ShellCheck 0.11.0 inline directives for actionlint
description: Is a typed representation of project-wide ShellCheck directives.
markdownDescription: Is a typed representation of project-wide ShellCheck directives.

disable.title: disable
disable.description: Lists codes, code ranges or all, for example [SC2086, SC3000-SC4000].
disable.markdownDescription: Lists codes, code ranges or all, for example [SC2086, SC3000-SC4000].

enable.title: enable
enable.description: Lists optional check names, or all. ShellCheck validates available names.
enable.markdownDescription: Lists optional check names, or all. ShellCheck validates available names.

extended-analysis.title: extended-analysis
extended-analysis.description: Enables or disables ShellCheck dataflow analysis. Omission keeps its default.
extended-analysis.markdownDescription: Enables or disables ShellCheck dataflow analysis. Omission keeps its default.

external-sources.title: external-sources
external-sources.description: Controls following sourced files. Omission preserves actionlint's enabled default.
external-sources.markdownDescription: Controls following sourced files. Omission preserves actionlint's enabled default.

shell.title: shell
shell.description: Overrides the inferred dialect of scripts selected for ShellCheck.
shell.markdownDescription: Overrides the inferred dialect of scripts selected for ShellCheck.

source-path.title: source-path
source-path.description: Lists directories searched for sourced files, relative to the run step's effective working directory. Scripts arrive on stdin, so SCRIPTDIR does not denote the workflow file's directory.
source-path.markdownDescription: Lists directories searched for sourced files, relative to the run step's effective working directory. Scripts arrive on stdin, so SCRIPTDIR does not denote the workflow file's directory.
